# A CAD book whose accounts run four levels deep, which is one deeper than
# GnuCash's statements list by default.
#
#   Assets                        (level 1, holds nothing itself)
#   Assets:Bank                   (level 2, holds nothing itself)
#   Assets:Bank:Chequing          (level 3, holds 300.00 CAD)
#   Assets:Bank:Chequing:Payroll  (level 4, holds 700.00 CAD)
#
# GnuCash's own statements default `Accounts / Levels of Subaccounts` to 3, and
# at that limit its account table folds the fourth level into the third: its
# page prints one row, `Chequing C$1,000.00`, and no Payroll row at all
# (measured on 5.10). A block lists every account instead, each line stating
# only what that account itself holds, so this book prints both 300.00 and
# 700.00 and the reader can see where the money is.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:Chequing
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:Chequing:Payroll
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Fees
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Fees:Late
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-02 * "Opening, split between the third and fourth levels"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:Chequing 300.00 CAD
	Assets:Bank:Chequing:Payroll 700.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -1000.00 CAD

2026-02-01 * "A late fee, booked three levels down under Income"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:Chequing:Payroll 50.00 CAD
	Income:Fees:Late -50.00 CAD
